name: vtkPointGaussianMapper
definition: A mapper that renders point clouds as simple points or anisotropic 3D Gaussian splats without requiring verts cells, supporting per-point scale, rotation, opacity, and emissive properties.
summary: vtkPointGaussianMapper renders point clouds as simple points or anisotropic 3D Gaussian splats using CPU-side object-order processing and vertex shader projection instead of GPU-parallel tile-based rasterization.
